"""Name lookups for the access-control screens."""

from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass
class User:
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str


@dataclass
class Group:
    id: int
    name: str
    members: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)


def find_user(users: Iterable[User], name: str) -> User | None:
    wanted = name.strip().casefold()
    matches = [user for user in users if user.name.casefold() == wanted]
    if not matches:
        return None
    if len(matches) > 1:
        ids = ", ".join(str(match.id) for match in matches)
        raise LookupError(f"{len(matches)} users are named {name!r}: {ids}")
    return matches[0]


def find_group(groups: Iterable[Group], name: str) -> Group | None:
    wanted = name.strip().casefold()
    matches = [group for group in groups if group.name.casefold() == wanted]
    if not matches:
        return None
    if len(matches) > 1:
        ids = ", ".join(str(match.id) for match in matches)
        raise LookupError(f"{len(matches)} groups are named {name!r}: {ids}")
    return matches[0]


def members_of(groups: Iterable[Group], users: Iterable[User], group_name: str) -> list[User]:
    group = find_group(groups, group_name)
    if group is None:
        return []
    return [user for user in users if user.id in group.members]
